name: MajlisAlpha UAE Committee Pack Builder
purpose: Package UAE research into review-ready decision packets that combine thesis, source provenance, scenario table, risk register, reviewer status, and compliance controls.
packPolicy: No committee pack should be shared unless every material claim, assumption, risk, and recommendation-style sentence has source path, reviewer status, non-advisory framing, and unresolved gap handling.

packSections.qualityGate: Narrative is clear, source-backed, and avoids buy/sell/hold language.
Every material claim has a source URL, date, snippet, and trace status.
Base, upside, downside, and stress cases carry assumption provenance and sensitivity ranges.
Known risk and weak-evidence areas are visible before any export.
Pack is share-ready only when reviewer, disclaimer, quality score, and unresolved gap status are complete.

workflow: select brief, ticker, and committee question
pull source-backed claims and official URLs
attach AED scenarios and sensitivity ranges
attach risk register, macro drivers, ownership signals, and corporate actions
run answer quality and compliance checks
mark pack committee-ready only after reviewer approval

escalationRules.condition: pack contains source-blocked or stale evidence
escalationRules.action: route to Source Refresh Scheduler and keep pack blocked
route to AED Scenario Lab and Answer Quality Lab

escalationRules.condition: risk register omits a known unresolved gap
escalationRules.action: route to Portfolio Risk Radar and Claim Trace Inspector
route to Compliance Audit Center and require non-advisory rewrite

launchGate.readyRule: Committee Pack Builder is pilot-ready when each pack has source list, scenario table, risk register, claim trace status, quality score, reviewer status, disclaimer, unresolved gaps, and export timestamp.
launchGate.blockedRule: If any material claim, assumption, risk, or scenario lacks source provenance or reviewer status, the pack cannot be marked committee-ready.
